explication: AM32 is embedded ESC firmware for brushless motors, with MCU-specific hardware support and a shared control application. The principal workflow is that a flight controller or configurator supplies throttle/control input; the firmware processes it and drives the motor, while ESC telemetry can be returned. The README also documents firmware updating, crawler-oriented builds, and multiple input protocols. The shared entry point and target configuration are identified in source excerpts; many feature-specific implementation links are based on documented capabilities because their source was not sampled.
